subject: Pemberton living room: video and swatches
snippet: Hi Jessica,  I was at Dumbarton this afternoon. The video of the living room is in the Pem
body:
Hi Jessica,

I was at Dumbarton this afternoon. The video of the living room is in the Pemberton Living room folder on Drive (IMG_5290): I held the laser with its back flat on the window wall and shot straight across to the far wall, so it's the long wall corner to corner. It read 13' 4", and I filmed it so we have it. The four Halden swatches are photographed too (IMG_5301 to IMG_5304), one colourway each with its tag. My phone did odd things with the colours under the studio lights, sorry. Claire kept the physical swatches.

The order list for the room is set up in Notion.

Emma is collecting the pine shelves and the crates on Sunday, so the wall will be clear.

Have a lovely weekend,
Priya
